description: Petroleum and Natural Gas Activity Indicators, 2004 to 2011 Tbl A1.12 is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. A tabular presentation of British Columbia petroleum and natural gas activity indicators, 2004 - 2011; production exclusive of gas retieved from storage; revenue inclusive of Crown Royalties, Crown reserve disposition bonuses, fees, and rentals (Sources: Ministry of Energy and Mines). Coverage: Government of British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Government of British Columbia | Gouvernment de la Colombie-Britannique. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
